title: Offline File Bridge
summary: Keep approved folders ready offline and open their files in other apps.
smallest_useful_product: Android APK using the Storage Access Framework to maintain user-approved offline mirrors, show freshness and storage state, and expose a share/open-with action without broad filesystem access.
success_measure: In offline-device tests, 95% of files marked ready open through a second target app with an accurate freshness status.
constraints: Android scoped storage and battery policies; explicit folder consent; device encryption; no claim that content is current without a successful sync.
